description: Timers and alarms by voice for any Assist satellite whose area has the four helpers timer.<area>_timer, input_datetime.<area>_alarm_time, input_boolean.<area>_alarm and input_select.<area>_ringing, plus input_number.<area>_timer_length for the Show card's Reset (bedroom only so far; typed Assist with no device uses the bedroom). Sentence triggers win over HA's built-in timer intents, which keep timers on the satellite where no screen can see them. Ringing, snooze and the screen overlay are in "Voice Timers and Alarms - Ringing" and the Show card (option `clock`).

command: how (long|much time) [is] left [on the timer|on my timer]
how long until the timer [goes off|finishes]

variables.area: {% set a = area_id(trigger.device_id) if trigger.device_id else none %}{{ a if a and states('input_select.' ~ a ~ '_ringing') not in ['unknown','unavailable'] else ('bedroom' if not trigger.device_id else '') }}

then.set_conversation_response: Timers and alarms aren't set up in this room yet.
Sorry, I didn't catch how long.

sequence.set_conversation_response: {% macro say(s) %}{% set h = s // 3600 %}{% set m = (s % 3600) // 60 %}{% set x = s % 60 %}{% set p = [] %}{% if h %}{% set p = p + [h ~ ' hour' ~ ('s' if h != 1 else '')] %}{% endif %}{% if m %}{% set p = p + [m ~ ' minute' ~ ('s' if m != 1 else '')] %}{% endif %}{% if x %}{% set p = p + [x ~ ' second' ~ ('s' if x != 1 else '')] %}{% endif %}{{ p | join(' and ') if p | count < 3 else p[:2] | join(', ') ~ ' and ' ~ p[2] }}{% endmacro %}Timer set for {{ say(secs | int) | trim }}.

{% macro say(s) %}{% set h = s // 3600 %}{% set m = (s % 3600) // 60 %}{% set x = s % 60 %}{% set p = [] %}{% if h %}{% set p = p + [h ~ ' hour' ~ ('s' if h != 1 else '')] %}{% endif %}{% if m %}{% set p = p + [m ~ ' minute' ~ ('s' if m != 1 else '')] %}{% endif %}{% if x %}{% set p = p + [x ~ ' second' ~ ('s' if x != 1 else '')] %}{% endif %}{{ p | join(' and ') if p | count < 3 else p[:2] | join(', ') ~ ' and ' ~ p[2] }}{% endmacro %}{% if is_state(timer, 'active') %}{% set s = ((as_datetime(state_attr(timer, 'finishes_at')) - now()).total_seconds()) | round(0) | int %}{{ say(s) | trim }} left.{% elif is_state(timer, 'paused') %}{% set r = state_attr(timer, 'remaining').split(':') %}{% set s = (r[0] | int) * 3600 + (r[1] | int) * 60 + (r[2] | float | int) %}The timer is paused with {{ say(s) | trim }} left.{% else %}There's no timer running.{% endif %}

then.set_conversation_response: Sorry, I didn't catch the time.

sequence.set_conversation_response: Alarm set for {% set a = as_datetime(states(alarm_time)) | as_local %}{% set d = (a.date() - now().date()).days %}{{ a.strftime('%-I:%M %p') | replace(':00 ', ' ') | lower | replace(' am', ' a.m.') | replace(' pm', ' p.m.') }}{{ ' today' if d == 0 else ' tomorrow' if d == 1 else ' on ' ~ a.strftime('%A') }}.

{% if is_state(armed, 'on') %}Your alarm is set for {% set a = as_datetime(states(alarm_time)) | as_local %}{% set d = (a.date() - now().date()).days %}{{ a.strftime('%-I:%M %p') | replace(':00 ', ' ') | lower | replace(' am', ' a.m.') | replace(' pm', ' p.m.') }}{{ ' today' if d == 0 else ' tomorrow' if d == 1 else ' on ' ~ a.strftime('%A') }}.{% else %}There's no alarm set.{% endif %}
